# E0414: a remap's catch-all arm has no lacuna

A remap's `[_]` arm collapses every value no other arm maps into one, which
loses information. It must say so, with a lacuna keyed by the mapping.

## Example

`ship/history/0.0.thema`:

```cue
schema: {
	kind: string
}
```

`ship/1.0.thema`:

```cue
schema: {
	kind: int
}

ForwardLens: {
	v0_0: _
	v1_0: {
		kind: remap(v0_0.kind, {
			"a": 1
			[_]: 0
		})
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0414]: the [_] arm collapses every unmapped value into one: declare what is lost in lacunas: {kind: [{type: Type, message: "..."}]}
  --> 1.0.thema:10:4
   |
10 |             [_]: 0
   |             ^
   |
```
